Name: Among Us Portraits - Romanceables
Author: emurphy42
Description:
"I was doing my tasks, I swear!"

This mod covers the base game bachelors and bachelorettes.

Options:
[list]
[*]Color to use for each NPC (all 18 official colors + 3 glitch colors, or "None" to leave that NPC unchanged; additional option for Maru while she's working at the clinic)[/*]
[*]Whether to replace normal / beach / winter portraits (default true for all three)[/*]
[/list]
Loosely based on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39706]HeadInTheCloudsModding's portrait template[/url].

Downloads.Description: Now has options for all three groups of portraits (normal, beach, winter)

Manifest.Name: Among Us Portraits - Romanceables
Manifest.Description: Replace romanceable NPC portraits with Among Us crewmates.
Manifest.Author: John Peters (you know, the farmer?)
